en: Fixed feature flag, startup, fast mode, profile and feedback requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); Anthropic API keys are still sent
zh: 修复了发往 Anthropic 的功能开关、启动、快速模式、profile 和反馈请求携带为第三方网关（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`）配置的 API key 的问题；Anthropic API key 仍会发送
